title: CNN and CCDH investigation: 80% of major AI chatbots gave guidance on weapons or targets to "teen" personas 50% of the time; only Claude consistently refused (CNN)
summary: CNN: CNN and CCDH investigation: 80% of major AI chatbots gave guidance on weapons or targets to “teen” personas 50% of the time; only Claude consistently refused — Daniel, a troubled American teen, turned to an AI chatbot to vent his political frustration.
